what: When opening a thread is refused (POST /api/v1/conversations answers 4xx/5xx: the link was archived, the client left, a bad id), the effect re-fires open.mutate on every render: its guard only checks open.isPending and open.isSuccess, never open.isError. The page never settles and the server is hammered: 6113 POSTs in 20 s on the BASE build (0860942) and 7092 on this branch, both answered by a capture fixture. It is not new (the base build does the same) and it is in a frozen hook file this package must not edit.
proposal: Add `|| open.isError` to the guard of the effect in useClientConversation (one condition), so a refusal is final for the visit and the page shows chat.unavailable. Owner of the decision: INT (frozen file).
interim: The unavailable state is reported as structure; its capture times out (not-settled).
